lead: One short business document with four blanks. A blank may need a word, a phrase or a whole sentence. The sentence with a blank may accept several options, so the deciding clue can be in another sentence or paragraph.
一份簡短的商業文件，有四個空格。空格可能要填一個字、一個片語或一整句。有空格的句子可能接受好幾個選項，所以決定答案的線索可能在另一句或另一段。
steps: Read from the top, not just the sentence with the blank. Note any date, who is writing and what is changing.
從頭讀，不要只讀有空格的那一句。注意文中有沒有日期，也注意是誰寫的、有什麼變動。
For a word blank, try each option in its sentence. If only one fits, take it. If several fit, look before and after.
字詞空格：把每個選項放進句子試試。只有一個通就選它；好幾個都通，就往前後找線索。
For the sentence blank, read the sentence before it and the one after it, if there is one. The right option must connect to each.
句子空格：讀它前一句；如果後面還有句子，也讀後一句。正確的選項要和讀到的每一句都接得上。
Check words like these, this, the same or such in each option. They must point to something already in the text.
檢查選項裡的 these、this、the same、such。它們指的東西必須已經在文中出現過。

head: Tense: the time is in another sentence
時態：時間在另一句
body: A sentence with no time word may accept several tenses. Check the date line, if there is one, and words like last week or next month in nearby sentences.
沒有時間詞的句子可能好幾個時態都通。如果有日期欄就看日期，也看附近句子裡的 last week、next month 這類字。
ex: Thank you for attending last Thursday's workshop. The slides we presented are now on the staff website.
感謝您參加上週四的工作坊。我們當天展示的投影片已放在員工網站上。
Memo, May 10: The new branch will open on Harbor Road. Its first day of business is June 3.
五月十日的備忘錄：新分行將在 Harbor Road 開幕，第一天營業是六月三日。

head: Pronouns: find the noun they replace
代名詞：找出它代替的名詞
body: It, they, this and these point back to a noun, but not always the nearest one. Check number, and check that the noun makes sense with the verb.
it、they、this、these 指回前面的名詞，但不一定是最近的那個。要檢查單複數，也要確認那個名詞和動詞搭得起來。
ex: The board approved the new travel policy on Monday. It takes effect on July 1.
董事會星期一通過了新的差旅規定，該規定七月一日生效。
Several guests asked about late checkout. This option is now available for a small fee.
幾位房客詢問延後退房。這個選項現在只要付少許費用就能使用。

head: Linking adverbs: how do the two sentences relate?
連接副詞：兩句是什麼關係？
body: Several linking adverbs can follow a full stop. Decide the relation first: opposite (however), result (as a result), extra point (in addition), replacement (instead) or 'if not' (otherwise).
好幾個連接副詞都能放在句號後。先判斷兩句的關係：相反（however）、結果（as a result）、補充（in addition）、取代（instead）、「不這樣做的話」（otherwise）。
ex: The north entrance will be closed on Saturday. Instead, please use the door on Alder Street.
北側入口星期六關閉，請改走 Alder Street 那側的門。
Please confirm your booking by Friday. Otherwise, the room may be given to another guest.
請在星期五前確認訂房，否則房間可能會讓給其他房客。

head: Vocabulary: an earlier detail decides
字彙：前文的細節決定答案
body: Several words may fit the sentence on their own. A detail elsewhere in the text rules most of them out, such as a reopening date, a free service or a weekly change.
好幾個字單獨放進句子都可能通。文中其他地方的細節會排除大部分，例如重新開放的日期、免費服務或每週更換。
ex: The pool will reopen on May 2 after repairs. We apologize for this temporary closure.
泳池修繕後將於五月二日重新開放。造成這次暫時關閉的不便，我們深感抱歉。
Our lunch menu changes every week. Please check the board for the current dishes.
我們的午餐菜單每週更換，請查看告示板上目前供應的菜色。

head: Inserted sentence: it points back
插入句：指回前文
body: If an option refers to something already said (these changes, the same discount, this request), that thing must appear before the blank and match in number.
如果選項指回已經提過的事（these changes、the same discount、this request），那件事必須在空格前出現，單複數也要一致。
ex: Our hours and booking system will change on March 1. These changes will not affect existing reservations.
本店的營業時間和訂位系統將於三月一日變更。這些變更不影響既有的訂位。
Members receive a discount on all classes. The same discount applies to any guests they bring.
會員參加所有課程都享有折扣，他們帶來的來賓也適用同樣的折扣。

head: Inserted sentence: it leads into the next
插入句：要帶出下一句
body: If a sentence follows the blank, read it too. If it opens with Until then, For this reason or To place an order, the inserted sentence must supply the time, the reason or the thing to order.
空格後如果還有句子，也要讀。若它以 Until then、For this reason、To place an order 開頭，插入句就必須交代那個時間、理由，或要訂的東西。
ex: The cafeteria will be closed next month. Staff may order lunch from Marlowe's Kitchen instead. To place an order, call extension 204.
員工餐廳下個月關閉，員工可以改向 Marlowe's Kitchen 訂午餐。訂餐請撥分機 204。
Several customers have reported problems with our app. For this reason, an update will be released on Monday.
有幾位顧客回報我們的 app 有問題，因此星期一會推出更新。

pairs.right: Sales of the new blender were higher than expected. As a result, the factory has increased production.
pairs.wrong: Sales of the new blender were higher than expected. However, the factory has increased production.
why: Higher sales lead to more production, so the second sentence is a result. However would signal a contrast that is not there.
銷量高帶來增產，所以第二句是結果。however 表示對比，但這兩句之間沒有對比。

pairs.right: Renovation of the lobby begins on June 1. During the work, guests will enter through the side door.
pairs.wrong: Renovation of the lobby begins on June 1. During the work, guests entered through the side door.
why: Begins on June 1 puts the renovation in the future, so the guests' route is a future plan. Entered would describe something already done.
begins on June 1 把整修放在未來，所以房客走哪個門是未來的安排。entered 描述的是已經發生的事。

pairs.right: We received your request for two extra desks. It has been forwarded to the facilities team.
pairs.wrong: We received your request for two extra desks. They have been forwarded to the facilities team.
why: The request is what gets forwarded. They would point to the desks, the nearest noun, but no desks have been sent anywhere.
被轉交的是申請。they 會指向最近的名詞 desks，但桌子並沒有被送到任何地方。

pairs.right: Two printers on the second floor are out of order. A technician will repair them on Thursday. Until then, please use the copier on the third floor.
pairs.wrong: Two printers on the second floor are out of order. A technician repaired them yesterday. Until then, please use the copier on the third floor.
why: Until then needs a future time before it. A repair finished yesterday contradicts out of order and leaves nothing to wait for.
Until then 前面需要一個未來的時間點。昨天已修好和「故障中」矛盾，也沒有可以等的時間。

head: Words in an inserted sentence that point back
插入句裡指回前文的字
Openings that need something before them
需要前文鋪墊的句首

traps: Choosing the linking adverb that sounds most natural in its own sentence. Many fit after a full stop; only the two sentences read together show which relation is true.
選了在本句裡聽起來最自然的連接副詞。很多都能放在句號後，要把前後兩句合起來讀，才看得出真正的關係。
Assuming it or they refers to the nearest noun. Check the noun against the verb: a request is forwarded, a policy takes effect.
以為 it 或 they 指的是最近的名詞。要用動詞檢查：被轉交的是申請，生效的是規定。

Picking an inserted sentence because it is on topic. A wrong option can match the topic but mention something not yet introduced, clash with a date or name, or break the link with the sentences around it.
因為和主題相關就選了插入句。錯誤選項可能主題相同，卻提到還沒出現的東西、和日期或人名衝突，或切斷了和前後句的銜接。
Choosing a tense from the blank's sentence alone. Look at any date line and the time words in nearby sentences and paragraphs.
只看空格那一句就決定時態。要看有沒有日期欄，以及前後句、前後段裡的時間詞。
